data.name: A Healthier Earth
data.description: A Healthier Earth (AHE) is the UK climate-tech R&D subsidiary of Pure Data Centres Group, operating the £24M PureBiochar facility in Royal Wootton Bassett, Wiltshire — billed as the UK's largest biochar plant. The site began phase 1 commissioning in November 2025 and at full capacity is designed to produce ~11,500 tonnes of biochar annually, removing up to 18,500 tonnes of CO2, using PYREG PX6000/PX1500/P500 pyrolysis equipment. AHE also runs ForestFactory, a reforestation partnership with Blenheim Palace.
